newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Admiralty Investment acquires Tang Dynasty City.
newsitem.headline: Admiralty Investment acquires Tang Dynasty City.

text.p: Admiralty Investment Holdings Pte Ltd (AIH), the owner of the Admiralty Resort and Country Club, said in a statement on Monday it is acquiring Tang Dynasty City for Singapore $47 million.
Tang Dynasty City is a site which contains a Chinese-style theme park. It is 95 percent owned by Far East Holdings International Ltd.
The acquisition has been made by AIH's subsidiary, Admiralty Leisure Pte Ltd, in which AIH owns 65 percent of the shares. The remaining 35 percent is held by Tang Dynasty City Pte Ltd.
